title: Dispatch: olc5.15 Ring of Djinni death -> nonmagical via item_state_event; Staff of the Python 0-HP destroy; Efreeti curation fix (attempt 1, Sonnet)
description:
Implements eshyra-olc5.15. Read `bd show eshyra-olc5.15` first: its description, acceptance criteria and the 2026-10-18 USER CORRECTION note are the spec. Also read docs/rules-pack-compiler.md and docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. The importer protocol is MANDATORY because the generated pack changes. Locate code by symbol name.

BASE: branch eshyra-olc5.15, cut from eshyra-olc5.14 @ 9d188ced (PR #674, open: Horn variants plus countRoll; the Horn and the vessels are now owned; CONFORMANCE_BACKED lists horn blow-horn). Build on it; do not change olc5.14 behaviour.

GOAL: two printed item consequences of a creature's death are not lost or conflated with ordinary endings, plus one curation correction.
1. Ring of Djinni Summoning: "the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies".
2. Staff of the Python: on 0 HP, "it dies and reverts to its staff form. The staff then shatters and is destroyed."
3. Efreeti Bottle: correct the curation; add no transition.

CODE SURVEY (verified by the captain on origin/main)
- Curated grant specs are in magicItemEntityGrants.ts:
  - Ring: grant particular-djinni, onEntityDeath 'make the ring nonmagical'.
  - Staff: python-form, onEntityDeath '...staff shatters and is destroyed'.
  - Efreeti: hostile-efreeti, onEntityDeath 'resolve the efreeti's normal death; the bottle outcome remains spent'.
  - Triage strips onEntityDeath from the pack.
  - MAGIC_ITEM_ENTITY_GRANT_KEYS_WITH_DEATH_CONSEQUENCE feeds creatureGrantLifecycleOwned (magicItemGrantOwnership.ts) to keep those grants pending.
- The DM-reported event channel already exists: the item_state_event tool (orchestrator/toolItemStateEvent.ts -> applyItemStateConditionEvent in state/itemResetExecutor.ts). "The DM determines whether it occurred"; the condition must exactly match a declared transition from the current state; anything else is refused with no change.
- The lifecycle status 'nonmagical' already exists in item state (state/itemState.ts lifecycle.status 'consumed'|'inert'|'nonmagical'). A nonmagical instance's later use is refused (see the itemState.ts check on state?.lifecycle?.status === 'nonmagical').
- The Ring has an item_state row (its 24-hour grant-ended cooldown economy). Its m4 is engine-pending only because of the death-consequence guard. Its c1-cooldown is green.
- Destroying an instance goes through destroyInventoryItem (state/inventoryLifecycle.ts), which tombstones live grant bindings (S11) and voids open bind credits.
- Grant endings: ITEM_GRANT_REVERT_DISPOSITIONS in activeEffects.ts maps 'reduced-to-0-hit-points' to { kind: 'zero-hit-points' }. Every ending calls applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent in the same transaction.
- The Staff's m4 stays KEPT (owner-bonus-action-command is DM-ended; mental-command control). Its become-python operation is readiness-refused on the real pack. That refusal must stay.
- Efreeti: its bottle-loses-magic outcomes are table outcomes (table:efreeti-bottle). They are honestly represented: m8 is engine-pending (random procedure) and the table record is green. olc5.12.4 (PR #671) fixed only the bindGrant hint text.

DECISIONS
1. RING
   - Declare a source-backed external-event transition on the Ring, e.g. the condition "the djinni dies" -> lifecycle nonmagical. Apply it through the EXISTING item_state_event path: the DM adjudicates that the particular djinni died, as opposed to dropping to 0 HP and returning home.
   - It must work whether or not a summon is active (user correction 2026-10-18). When a particular-djinni grant IS active on that instance, end that grant in the SAME transaction, with an ending reason that records the death.
   - The ending must not schedule the ordinary 24-hour cooldown as if it were a normal departure. Record which choice you made and why: either no cooldown is scheduled, or scheduling it is harmless because the ring is now nonmagical.
   - The transition is durable, attributable (provenance/session) and idempotent: a second event on an already-nonmagical ring is refused with no change.
   - Ordinary endings (concentration, one hour, 0 HP, dismissal) never make the ring nonmagical.
   - If the state-machine schema cannot express an external event whose effect is lifecycle nonmagical, add the MINIMAL typed field on the existing transition shape. Do not build a new event channel.
   - Then remove the Ring from the death-consequence guard, because the consequence is now typed and executed. If its m4 then becomes owned, summon-djinni becomes READY; it was ready at c58j.1 before the guard. That requires the real-pack no-waiver BIND row.
2. STAFF
   - Add a typed, source-backed coupling on the python-form grant: its 'reduced-to-0-hit-points' ending destroys the source instance in the same transaction as the ending. Destroy it through destroyInventoryItem, after the effect has ended, so no live binding is stranded.
   - The 'owner-bonus-action-command' reversion leaves the staff intact; restoring the snake's HP is the persistent actor's concern and needs no item state.
   - No dismissal path may bypass the destruction: a 0-HP end reported through any ending path must take the destroy branch.
   - The Staff stays KEPT and readiness-refused. Do not make it ready.
   - Remove the Staff from the death-consequence guard ONLY if the consequence is now executed. Otherwise keep it, with a reason.
3. EFREETI
   - Remove or reclassify the curated hostile-efreeti onEntityDeath (the source prints no death-triggered item transition), and record the reason in the spec comment.
   - The guard set then reflects real source consequences only.
   - Add no item transition. The Efreeti stays kept (DM-ended third-wish-granted).
4. COMPILER: a source-grounded consequence is either typed and executed, or kept with its verbatim sourceText in an adjudicated clause AND its grant not lifecycle-green. Keep a test that fails if triage strips a typed consequence the runtime does not execute.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE (minimum)
- Ring, real unmodified pack, no waiver:
  (a) summon -> bind -> DM item_state_event "the djinni dies": the grant ends, the ring is nonmagical, and a later summon is refused.
  (b) with no summon active, the same event makes the ring nonmagical.
  (c) an ordinary end (0 HP or one hour) leaves the ring magical, and only the cooldown starts.
- Staff, binder/ending level using the real-pack record (it is not ready, so no waiver in production code): a 0-HP ending destroys the instance in the same transaction, and the bonus-action reversion does not.
- Efreeti: the guard-set test is updated to the corrected set.
- Update baselines without weakening them, and add the thaw note.

RECORD in notes: before/after counts, the readiness delta, the cooldown-on-death choice, and any schema field added.

VERIFY: run the focused suites, `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`, and `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing.

STOP and record (leave the bead open) if: the Ring's nonmagical transition cannot use item_state_event without a new event channel; or the Staff destruction would need a generic death engine.

Pack regenerated via import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1; thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-19-eshyra-olc5-15-1-grant-death-consequences.md; semi-structured boundary inventory regenerated (1860->1862 rows).
COUNTS (magic-item readiness clauses): engine-pending 783->782, green 233->235, adjudicated-by-design 366->367, design-blocked 1->1, total 1383->1385. Legacy hook-backed backlog 805->806 (one new green clause m4-lifecycle-ring-of-djinni-summoning). Records changed: Ring of Djinni Summoning (new stateMachine, entityGrant clause pending->green, +adjudicated m4-control clause, +green lifecycle clause) and Staff of the Python (grant field destroysItemOn only). Efreeti pack record unchanged (onEntityDeath was stripped from pack already).
READINESS DELTA: Ring summon-djinni becomes READY (was ready at c58j.1 before the guard); real-pack no-waiver evidence itemStateEventNonmagical.test.ts, listed in CONFORMANCE_BACKED. Staff stays KEPT/engine-pending/readiness-refused (verified in test). Efreeti unchanged (m4 and m8 engine-pending, table:efreeti-bottle outcomes verbatim in the table record, green).
COOLDOWN-ON-DEATH CHOICE: NO cooldown is scheduled. applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent returns early when the instance lifecycle is nonmagical, and the item_state_event path writes the nonmagical lifecycle BEFORE ending grants. Reason: a death is not an ordinary departure and the ring is never summoned again; ordinary endings (0 HP, 1 hour) unchanged and only start the 24h cooldown (tested).
SCHEMA ADDED (minimal, on existing shapes): stateMachine transition field becomes?: 'nonmagical' (only with condition); entityGrant grant field destroysItemOn?: 'reduced-to-0-hit-points' (must be in revertOn); binding record field destroysSourceAtZeroHp (stored at bind). No new event channel: Ring uses item_state_event; item_state validator additionally licenses lifecycle nonmagical when a becomes transition targets the current machineState. item_state_event result gains becameNonmagical/grantsEnded.
DESIGN: Ring end reason source-removed/detail creature-died; ends ALL live grants bound to the instance (only one exists on the Ring). Staff: finalizeEnd (single choke point) destroys the instance via destroyInventoryItem after the effect ends when the binding has the flag and the ending detail is zero-hit-points (covers update_combatant 0 HP and end_effect with that detail under source-removed/dismissed/dispelled); bonus-action reversion ('ruled') leaves staff intact.
GUARD: MAGIC_ITEM_ENTITY_GRANT_KEYS_WITH_DEATH_CONSEQUENCE is now EMPTY (Ring typed+executed, Staff typed+executed, Efreeti curated note removed with recorded reason in the spec comment); kept as fail-closed mechanism. New ownership test pins every typed form (becomes / destroysItemOn) to its executor and fails if the pack carries an unlisted typed consequence.
DEVIATIONS: (1) Ring's lifecycle clause tagged M4 not M5 (M5 census pins 50 items in several tests); (2) Ring added to new KEPT_EXTERNAL_EVENT_MACHINES in triage instead of KEPT_STATE_MACHINES (the latter is pinned by tests as activation-entered single-lifetime machines); (3) transition/state notes omitted from pack because a corpus test requires state-machine notes to be verbatim printed spans (rationale is in the spec comment); (4) test pins updated with documented reasons, none weakened: legacy backlog 805->806 + fingerprint, srdGeneratedPack clause counts, triage census 21->22 machines, operation-source-agreement READY +Ring summon-djinni and machine census 22, compiler landed-hooks registry +1 hook, grant-ownership partition (Ring owned; guard set empty). No STOP condition hit.
FOLLOW-UPS: none required. Note: existing saved campaigns holding a Ring item_state row created before this pack lack machineState and would need re-initialisation on the pack re-freeze (pre-freeze, not a live concern).
